title: A-Rank Party wo Ridatsu shita Ore wa, Moto Oshiego-tachi to Meikyuu Shinbu wo Mezasu.

alternative_titles.en: I Left My A-Rank Party to Help My Former Students Reach the Dungeon Depths!
alternative_titles.ja: Aランクパーティを離脱した俺は、元教え子たちと迷宮深部を目指す。

synopsis:
In a world where livestreamed adventures is the most popular content, Yuke Feldio belongs to the well-known A-rank party known as Thunder Pike. One day, however, he decides to quit after not receiving a fair share of the earnings. While signing up for new work, Yuke suddenly reunites with his former students: Marina, Rain, and Silk Amberwood. Moreover, he decides to join their party despite their mere D-rank status.

Soon, the party heads out for their first dungeon expedition. With Yuke's exceptional support magic and the girls' diverse fighting skills, the group blazes through all of their enemies. As they give their party the name Clover and reach an infamous boss, Yuke decides to take it on alone while streaming the whole fight. To his surprise, the broadcast quickly goes viral, gaining thousands of views! Continuing to stream more quests and teaching the girls more about adventuring, Yuke is determined to take Clover to the top.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
